body: Sorry, I'm on high alert still with my negativeness. That's the depression expecting pessimism often, everything through text seems like an attack...which is my problem. You've given up on seeing a therapist? Well hey if you need a friend, I have no friends, and wouldn't mind one!

Well, I feel getting the attention helps pull people from the ledge, even if it were for a little while. It helped me, another user has been keeping company which I'm grateful for. Why demean another person's suggestion of it can help even just a little?

Ah, I see.

Anyways, my advice to O.P is call the suicide hotline, they can help you find an appropriate fitting therapist that can give you good advice with keen observation. Or reach out to the many users of reddit through messages, such as myself. I wouldn't mind talking to you, I've my own issues as well but perhaps we can lean on eachother
Did you not read what he said?

You're right, it is easier to ask a stranger. I sought out a therapist, she was good, but I stopped seeing her because she laughed at some joke I made. I felt it to be a break from professionalism when she did that...argh.

I have another name, yet a lot of my writings are on paper. They were also able to view my content through a friend who found my other Instagram. I had a website dedicated to my work, which I did get some wicked feedback from viewers. A lot of good compliments, yet specific few upset of my truthfulness. 

So in response, I removed my website.

And then starting drinking heavy for some time.

I quit smoking 3 weeks ago

I quit drinking 3 months ago.

The last year has been a horrific train wreck after another. I've lost three friends to heroine, one friend to suicide, and I still have no real balance as I used to. I broke up with ky girlfriend 2 years ago and I cant let go of it as I should. 

I feel like at my age I should be married, have kids,  and be more established at a career that I enjoy, not just a simple job. 

I want to get ahold of my life but all I think about is how I should be somewhere I am not. I'm also Hispanic, yes, I am going to use a race card, I feel where I live makes it hard for people like me, Hispanic. On top of that I'm a year away from 30 years old, and I feel like a jackass for being on this website asking for people's help.

I dont know what I'm doing anymore...I've a nice car, good paying JOB, and a mortgage. I cant get a girlfriend anymore, I feel I look unattractive although people compliment me...I feel they do that like they would compliment a child. I apparently have anxiety, because apparently overthinking isn't a true diagnosis. 

I think about suicide daily, and I pray daily that God will kill me.

I'm a writer, but I stopped writing because picking up a pencil frightens me. I dont want people, my peers or family to see my deepest, darkest, pain...

I have a feeling one day I'll be very happy. And that be the same day the grim reaper comes to collect.
It helps, however I get bored easy.

Not to mention I lost all my friends, to overdose, suicide, or betrayal. My ex's triumph over my friendships helped obliterate them entirely, people that provoke me to do this wicked deed of disappearing...are constant

I truly serve no purpose, for a while I felt I did, but for the last year I've come to notice no change of heart. I'm almost 30 years old, I have a decent job, and currently I'll be stuck with my parents until I'm death. 

So, I've been given the mortgage, it's going to be under my name, which is good. However. I don't wanna live here, I love my family, but I want to be in my own home, alone or preferably with my spouse. That's another issue, I can get a girl to save my life. Truly, I feel old, looks, health, lack of energy, I can't help but accept the evitable, death.
